headline: Pep Guardiola after Man City guilty verdict: 'I am behind my club'
description: Pep Guardiola has released his first statement since Manchester City were found guilty of over 100 breaches of Premier League financial rules, saying "I am behind my club."

headline: Does Man City's guilty verdict impact Pep Guardiola's legacy as an all-time coaching great?
description: Pep Guardiola won 16 major honors as Man City manager. They all now count for nothing after the Premier League found the club guilty of systematically breaking financial rules.

headline: Ex-Man City chairman calls for club's directors to resign after Premier League guilty verdict
description: Former Manchester City chairman David Bernstein has called for the club's directors to step down after City were found guilty of serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules.

headline: Man City's Elliot Anderson no handball call was correct - PL panel
description: The referee and VAR were correct to rule that Manchester City's Elliot Anderson did not handle the ball against Sunderland, a Premier League panel ruled.

headline: Man City should be stripped of titles - Jamie Carragher
description: Manchester City should be stripped of the titles won during the period where they have been found guilty of breaching Premier League financial rules, Jamie Carragher said
